weekly_event_censoring: Compare only indicator observations inside the exact event window against that week frozen threshold computed from prior completed weeks; do not let later dates in a partially overlapping week cause an event hit. Non-event proxy uses completed weekly peaks.
post_cutoff: Use existing market history through 2026-10-13, new data no later than 2026-10-15; Test2 common complete quarters end2026Q2. Exclude incomplete latest week.
scope17: Read ValueN header per file, not fixed column indices, because schema changes after2023Q2. Operational core-system identifier is not a legal-entity identifier. Preserve strings like count/duration and shared notes.
